chunks: ʿUbayd ibn Zurārah narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام that he said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, when he had performed the ʿIshāʾ prayer, would retire to his bed and would not perform any prayer until the middle of the night.

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ: Abū ʿAbdillāh; the Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام in this chain
key_terms.رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah; the Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.رَوَىٰ: narrated; indicates transmission of the hadith
key_terms.فِرَاشِهِ: his bed; indicating that he went to rest
key_terms.يَنْتَصِفَ ٱللَّيْلُ: the night reaches its midpoint; midnight in the context of worship timing
key_terms.ٱلْعِشَاءَ: the ʿIshāʾ prayer; the night obligatory salat

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم do after the ʿIshāʾ prayer before midnight?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the practice of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم regarding the period after the ʿIshāʾ prayer. It indicates that he would rest after ʿIshāʾ and delay further prayer until midnight, relating to the timing of the night prayer.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1375 - Ubayd ibn Zurarah narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) that He said:
"The Messenger of Allah (sw), after performing the Isha prayer, would retire to his bed and would not perform any additional prayer until midnight."
